lines.say: 740 listings evaluated, 68 applied, 12 interviews, and 1 offer. That was the author's own job search.
career-ops is an open-source AI job search agent that runs locally in the AI coding CLI you already use.
You paste a job, and it first checks that the posting is still live.
Then it scores the job from 1 to 5 against your CV, before you spend an evening applying.
If the job is worth it, it tailors an ATS-friendly resume and a cover letter from your own experience.
It drafts the answer to every field, but it never submits. You review and click Submit yourself.
The scanner comes with 100+ companies ready to scan and 35+ search queries across major job boards.
A terminal dashboard tracks your pipeline with 6 filter tabs and 4 sort modes.
The repo has 73.9k stars, and it is free for candidates, forever.
To start, run npx @santifer/career-ops init, then open Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode in the folder.
